description:
## Problem
`RedirectHandler::Default` compares normalized hosts (www-stripped) but does not compare ports. This allows `https://example.com` → `https://example.com:8080`, potentially redirecting to a different service on the same host running on a non-standard port.

## File
- `src/vug/redirect_handler_default.cr` (lines 22-40)

## Fix
Include port in the origin comparison. At minimum, verify the target port is a standard HTTP (80) or HTTPS (443) port when the original request used a standard port.

## Acceptance
- Redirect from standard port to non-standard port on same host is rejected
- Legitimate same-origin redirects still work
- Existing redirect tests pass
- New test for port-based redirect rejection
title: Security: Harden redirect same-origin check to include port comparison
